name: Pip Install
description: Install Python dependencies only from an approved hash-locked requirements file.

requirements_file.description: Relative path to a requirements or constraints file. Contents are content-hash bound.

steps.description: Install the approved dependency set with hash enforcement and no implicit dependency resolution

constraints: The install is fixed to python3 -m pip install with --require-hashes and --no-deps
The reviewed requirements file contents are content-hash bound at approval time
The wrapper rejects nested requirements, editable installs, direct URLs, alternate indexes, and unhashed package entries
No extra index URLs or package specifiers can be injected through runtime inputs
invariants: The recipe does not allow unconstrained pip install package-name flows
Structured argv prevents hidden shell expansion
